verdict.rationale: Capacities has a built-in AI assistant, so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product, and the axis applies. However, all of the MCP evidence describes the opposite role. Capacities exposes its own MCP server, which external clients (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, custom MCP clients) connect to. Nothing shows the in-app AI connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.
